selection: Per run: validation raw localization F1@0.5; ties mean IoU then earlier step. SFT step 0 eligible. Choose configuration by mean selected validation F1 over all seeds. Lock all selections before any new test inference.
evaluation: After locking: selected and final checkpoint per stage/seed; report all stages, never pick winners on test. Raw primary, validation-fitted calibration secondary; compare SFT raw and calibrated. Bootstrap cases and report seed dispersion.
dense_reward: 0.5 * legacy box-set Jaccard@0.5 + 0.5 * 2*sum(one-to-one positive IoUs)/(n_pred+n_gold); same coordinate/NMS preprocessing as legacy.
limitations: Same fixed SFT start across RL seeds; historical test already inspected; new runs remain exploratory on this test split. Two training GPUs instead of historical four with same effective batch; no claim that this alone isolates historical reference effect. No test-derived diagnosis aliases in reward.
statistics: Report each seed and seed mean/std; paired bootstrap resamples 3 RL seeds and 36 cases, 4000 draws seed42, raw and calibrated baseline separately. CIs remain exploratory; no correction for historical test inspection.
